extraction.Name: Mary Rosa Guerue
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by Richard Jones March 12, 1918
extraction.Buyer: Mary Rosa Guerue Battelyoun and Lorenzo Battelyoun, husband, conveyed the land by deed to Joseph Valandra for $1700
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612664 issued; Southwest quarter section 13, township 40, north of range 26; receipt signed by the allottee but not dated; conveyance dated March 14, 1918; allottee's married name is Mary Rosa Guerue Battelyoun; husband is Lorenzo Battelyoun
